Component Atlas

Every React component in the Open Agents web app — a preview, its file, purpose, props and variants — plus the design tokens the whole surface is built from.

374 components · 10 areas · 306 previews · apps/web

How the previews are made. Each preview is static HTML built from the component's own Tailwind class strings, compiled with the project's real Tailwind v4 build and the real tokens from app/globals.css. So spacing, colour and shape are the component's own. What is not real: text content is placeholder, every icon is a generic circle because lucide-react is not loaded, and no component is executing — interactive and data-driven states are shown as one static snapshot. 68 entries render no UI of their own (contexts, providers, hooks, utilities) and are marked as such.
